# recorded
fix-failing-tests: Find the failing tests, fix each in its own worktree and verify each fix in another; nothing is merged or pushed.
  phases: Find, Fix, Verify
  finder: survey via file, terminal (worktree)
  fixer: builder via file, terminal (worktree)
  verifier: survey via file, terminal (worktree)
  agents with default arguments: at most 11
  installed: installed

research: Answer a question from web, documentation and code sources, reading the most cited ones and removing claims no read source supports.
  phases: Plan, Sweep, Read, Synthesize
  planner: survey via todo
  web-searcher: survey via web
  code-searcher: survey via file (worktree)
  web-reader: survey via web
  code-reader: survey via file (worktree)
  synthesizer: judge via todo
  agents with default arguments: at most 13
  installed: installed

review-branch: Review a branch with one reviewer per lens, try to refute each finding, and return one ranked report.
  phases: Collect, Review, Verify, Synthesize
  collector: survey via file, terminal (worktree)
  reviewers: reviewer-1, reviewer-2, reviewer-3 via file (worktree)
  verifier: judge via file (worktree)
  synthesizer: judge via todo
  agents with default arguments: at most 17
  installed: installed

ultracode: Understand the code, compare independent designs, implement the chosen one test-first in a worktree, then review it with review-branch.
  phases: Understand, Design, Choose, Implement, Review
  scout: survey via file (worktree)
  designers: judge via file (worktree)
  chooser: judge via todo
  implementer: builder via file, terminal (worktree)
  agents with default arguments: at most 23
  installed: installed
exit=0
